truths.CP2:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  -- one row per product sold in both quarters
  SELECT product_id
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY product_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN order_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN units ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' THEN units ELSE 0 END) > 0
) AS t
truths.CP4:
WITH line_costs AS (
  -- one row per order line in Q2 or Q3 2025, with its cost on its order date
  SELECT s.product_id,
         CASE WHEN s.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q3' END AS qtr,
         s.units, s.net_revenue_eur,
         s.units * ch.unit_cost_eur AS cost_eur
  FROM sales AS s
  JOIN cost_history AS ch
    ON ch.product_id = s.product_id
   AND s.order_date >= ch.valid_from
   AND (ch.valid_to IS NULL OR s.order_date <= ch.valid_to)
  WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
),
product_quarter AS (
  -- one row per product and quarter
  SELECT product_id, qtr, SUM(units) AS v, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue, SUM(cost_eur) AS cost
  FROM line_costs
  GROUP BY product_id, qtr
),
in_both_quarters AS (
  -- one row per product sold in both quarters
  SELECT q2.product_id,
         q2.v AS v2, q2.revenue / q2.v AS p2, q2.cost / q2.v AS c2,
         q3.v AS v3, q3.revenue / q3.v AS p3, q3.cost / q3.v AS c3
  FROM product_quarter AS q2
  JOIN product_quarter AS q3 ON q3.product_id = q2.product_id
  WHERE q2.qtr = 'Q2' AND q3.qtr = 'Q3'
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM((c3 - c2) * v3), 2) FROM in_both_quarters

CP1.explanation: Price, cost and mix compare a product's own per-unit values in the two quarters, which exist only for products sold in both; the others need their own line so the bridge still adds up.

CP5.explanation: A negative cost line means unit costs rose and took margin, and since the margin still rose the other lines outweighed it; net price per unit also moves with promotions, and mix here is measured, not a leftover.
